beats.prompt: The reference image shows a colossal seraph built from folded parchment, six ragged wings dripping glossy black goo, its head a blank folded paper mask weeping black, looming in a starless void over a wide black mirror. The goo keeps dripping in long slow strands and the pooled mirror ripples; drifting parchment pages float past its wings. Camera: low-angle wide shot, very slow push-in. Its blank mask and six wings stay fixed.

The reference image shows a man mid-descent, ivory wings snapping open with cold white flame racing every edge, folded pages around his raised hand, a black stain far below. He keeps plummeting, wings flaring, white flame streaking upward behind him. Camera: high-angle tracking shot descending with him. His clean-shaven face stays fixed.

The reference image shows a man with six ragged thinned wings firing thousands of folded paper cranes, each edged in cold white fire. The crane storm keeps streaking outward in a comet swarm, motion streaks and shockwave rings expanding across the frame. Camera: wide shot with a slight lateral track, swarm filling the frame. His clean-shaven face stays fixed.

The reference image shows a corrupted seraph whose wings are unfolded into a cathedral wall of stained parchment swallowing an incoming white crane swarm. The wall keeps expanding, tar tentacles snapping up the last cranes, goo brightening as it feeds. Camera: static colossal wide shot, slow steady push forward. Its blank paper mask stays fixed and faceless.

The reference images show a tidal ocean of glossy black tar surging upward from collapsed wings toward a small blazing white figure hanging above it. The wave keeps rising and rolling, goo screaming off its crest, his flame reflected in the slick. Camera: low angle, slow tilt up as the wave climbs. His white figure stays fixed.

The reference image shows a man re-folded into a single ivory blade diving into a tar wave, the ocean parting around him in a deep steaming canyon. He keeps diving through, the canyon walls screaming to white steam and collapsing behind him in black spray. Camera: fast tracking shot following the blade through the parting wave. His clean-shaven face stays fixed.

The reference images show a towering colossus of angular ivory plates facing an ever-growing mass of stained dripping pages. Both keep growing, goo dripping from one, white fire pouring off the other, the void shaking. Camera: extreme wide shot, slow crane upward revealing their scale.

The reference images show white flame and black tar locked in a blinding sphere at frame centre, two silhouettes inside it. Shockwave rings keep blasting outward, parchment shredding to confetti, lens bloom pulsing, the void bowing. Camera: locked wide shot with a subtle shake, very slow push toward the core.

The reference image shows a man bursting out of a burning sphere, all six wings detonating into uncountable paper blades in a radial star. The blades keep spiralling outward in every direction at once, the white star expanding as he breaks free. Camera: wide, gently rotating, fixed on the expanding radial storm. His clean-shaven face stays fixed.

The reference image shows a corrupted seraph unfolded into a cathedral nest of stained pages and tar tentacles, swallowing a blade storm, white blades glowing faintly inside it. The tentacles keep writhing, it swells, goo cascading off in curtains. Camera: slow push-in on the gorged mass. Its blank paper mask stays fixed and faceless.

The reference image shows a man compressed into a single white dart punching a thin perfect line of light through a black mass. The line keeps piercing in one side and out the other, the holes rimmed white and spraying black vapour, white fire glowing up inside the body. Camera: fast tracking shot following the dart's path through the body.

The reference images show white fire erupting from inside a corrupted seraph, its body crumbling to glowing dust with clean white cranes rising, a man landing in the foreground. The body keeps crumbling outward, tar boiling to vapour, the dust cloud expanding as the cranes rise through the wreckage. Camera: wide, slow pull-back revealing the empty void.
